description: This file defines a generic Memo class used for caching computed object values with dependency tracking. It provides mechanisms to determine if dependencies have changed before recomputing the cached value, optimizing performance by avoiding unnecessary recalculations.

classes.name: Memo
classes.description: A generic caching utility class for memoizing values with dependency change detection.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the cached value, recomputing it if dependencies have changed.

methods.name: checkDependencyChangedAndUpdate
methods.description: Checks if dependencies have changed based on hash codes and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Calculates hash code for dependencies, using identity hash if specified.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating Memo instances with different configurations.
